subject: Audit & access log export: snapshots, retention windows, and deletion proof
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finvero.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit/access logs — retention & export capabilities

Hi Camila,

Quick intro: I’m Sarah (Compliance at Finvero Health). We’re working through our platform assessment and need a clear answer on Redwood’s audit/access log policies. Specifically: 

- What are default retention windows for audit logs and access logs on the hosted Redwood API? Can these be extended for enterprise customers?
- Can we request an on-demand bulk export (for a date range) and what formats do you provide?
- Is there an integrity manifest or checksum for exported bundles?
- What proof do you provide that a log slice has been deleted (e.g., deletion certificate, timestamped manifest)?
- Are exports resident-located? We need EU-only residency for some customer subsets.

We’d like to capture this in our SOC evidence pack. If you already have a sample export layout, that’d be very helpful.

Thanks —
Sarah
Sarah Lim
Head of Compliance, Finvero Health

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finvero.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs — retention & export capabilities

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. TL;DR up front: hosted default 90 days, Dedicated/Private configurable up to multi-year; on-demand exports supported (NDJSON/CSV), exports include signed manifests (SHA256), and we provide deletion attestations for Private and deletion evidence for Hosted. Residency options are available (US/EU/APAC) depending on account configuration. Details below.

Retention: 
- Hosted (standard): audit and access logs retained for 90 days by default.
- Hosted (enterprise add-on): retention can be extended to 365 days with signed contract and storage commit (billing adjustment).
- Dedicated/Private: fully configurable retention policy; customers can request retention windows from 30 days to 7+ years depending on storage & contract.

Exports (on-demand & scheduled):
- Formats: NDJSON (preferred for event streams), CSV (summary rows), and compressed tar.gz bundles for bulk.
- Scope/filtering: time-range, customer tenant id, route/model, user-id (or hashed user-id) filters.
- Delivery: Hosted exports are generated by our export pipeline and delivered to a customer S3 bucket or a secure transfer link. Typical turnaround for on-demand hosted exports is up to 72 hours for large slices (>50GB).
- Dedicated/Private: exports can be initiated via API (export job endpoint) and streamed directly to the customer’s internal storage with near-immediate availability (subject to job queue).

Integrity & manifests: every export bundle includes a machine-signed manifest (manifest.json) containing: export_id, time-range, row-counts by event type, SHA256 checksums of files, and the key-id used to sign. We can provide the public key for verification on request.

Deletion proof / evidence: 
- Hosted: we provide a deletion event log showing deletion job id, timestamp, and affected export/log ranges. For regulatory evidence, we can produce a time-stamped deletion manifest and a signed statement describing the deletion job. Note: Hosted customers do not receive deletion certificates tied to their own KMS (unless they are on an enterprise keyed-hosted plan).
- Dedicated/Private: customers can opt for an auditable deletion workflow tied to their KMS (customer-managed keys). We will produce a deletion certificate (signed), with job ID, files removed, and verification checksums.

Residency & separation: 
- Data residency is enforced at the tenant level. For EU-only accounts we provision EU-region storage and exports are produced within the EU.
- For hybrid export needs we can route exports to a customer-designated region, with appropriate data transfer agreements.

PII & identifiers: by default exports include user identifiers pseudonymized (hashed). If you require additional masking (e.g., remove email addresses entirely), we can provide an export transform pipeline as part of Dedicated/Private deployments or as a managed-hosted add-on.

Attachments: I’m attaching a small sample CSV that lists typical export fields and a sample manifest JSON. I’ll also link a short Drive doc with the export SLAs and the HubSpot ticket for tracking.

If useful, let’s book a quick 20-min session to walk through an example export and show the manifest verification steps.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference

Attachment: audit_export_fields_sample.csv (see attached)

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finvero.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs — retention & export capabilities

Camila — this is very helpful, thank you. A couple quick clarifying questions: 

1) Chain-of-custody: does the manifest include a timestamp and signing cert that we can ingest into our evidence system? We need to demonstrate the export wasn’t altered after generation.
2) Keying: for hosted customers who request longer retention or deletion certificates, what key management options are available? Is customer-managed KMS required for deletion certificates?
3) PII: you mention pseudonymized IDs by default — can you confirm which fields are hashed vs included in plain text in the audit export sample? We need to confirm no raw emails or SSNs appear.
4) SLA / lead time: if we ask for a 365-day retention on hosted, is that bound to a procurement lead time? Any pricing ballpark?

Also — would prefer the export delivered to an EU S3 bucket (we’ll provide the bucket). Is that something you can schedule on the hosted side?

Best,
Sarah

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@finvero.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit/access logs — retention & export capabilities

Great questions — answers below. I’ll loop in Karthik (Sales) for the procurement/pricing and Mina (Product) for the masking behavior details.

1) Chain-of-custody: Yes — manifest.json includes export_timestamp (ISO8601), signer_id, and signature (RSA-PSS over the manifest). We publish the signer public key in the manifest header and maintain a rotation log. Your evidence system can validate signatures against that key.

2) Keying & deletion certificates: 
- Hosted: deletion evidence is provided as a signed Redwood statement (signed by Redwood key). If you require a certificate tied to a customer key, we offer an enterprise-hosted option where exports/deletions are signed using a customer-managed KMS (CMK) — that requires a contract amendment and KMS onboarding (2–4 weeks typical).
- Dedicated/Private: you can use your KMS (on-prem or cloud CMK) for signing; deletion certificates in this mode are generated using your key and therefore are directly verifiable against your KMS audit.

3) PII & fields: in the sample CSV: user_id (hashed SHA256), user_email (masked: firstchar+****@domain.com), ip_address (truncated to /24), raw_payload (excluded by default). Event-level metadata (route, model, timestamp, request_id) are included in clear text. If you need stricter masking (no masked emails even), we can apply additional redaction via transform pipelines. Mina — see attached note on masking options.

4) SLA / pricing / lead time: 
- Hosted 365-day retention: procurement lead time ~ 2–3 weeks (contract + storage configuration). Price uplift depends on expected log volume — typical ARR uplift ranges from 10–30% for retention to 365 days. I’ve asked Karthik to provide a ballpark and a formal quote.

5) EU S3 delivery: yes — we can deliver hosted exports to a customer-provided EU S3 bucket. We’ll need an IAM role ARN and the bucket details. Delivery to customer buckets for hosted exports is part of the enterprise export add-on.

Next steps: 
- I’ll attach the sample files now (audit_export_fields_sample.csv, redwood-export-manifest-example.json).
- Karthik will follow up with a pricing/quote and procurement timeline in a separate note.
- If you want, we can set up a 20-min call to run a live manifest verification.

Cheers,
Camila

Attachment: redwood-export-manifest-example.json (see attached)
